name: project-tutors-architecture
description: Key architecture details of the tutors SvelteKit app - markdown pipeline, content types, rendering flow
metadata:
  type: project
---

Tutors is a SvelteKit (Svelte 5 with runes) app for course content delivery. v15.2.0.

**Why:** Understanding the architecture is needed for any feature work on this codebase.

**How to apply:** Reference when modifying content rendering, adding content types, or working with the markdown pipeline.

## Stack
- SvelteKit + Svelte 5 (runes: `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$props`)
- Tailwind CSS 4, Skeleton UI v4 (`@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`)
- Vite, adapter-auto

## Markdown pipeline
- `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (external JSR package) owns `markdown-it` config with plugins: KaTeX, anchor, TOC, emoji, sub/sup/mark, footnote, deflist, custom video/podcast players
- Shiki for syntax highlighting (30+ langs, 7 themes), initialized in `src/lib/services/markdown/services/markdown.svelte.ts`
- `markdownIt` instance is **exported** and mutable - can add plugins from app side
- `convertMdToHtml(md, codeTheme)` is the core render function

## Content flow
1. Course JSON fetched from `{courseUrl}/tutors.json`
2. `decorateCourseTree()` walks tree, calls `convertLoToHtml()` for non-lab/non-note types
3. Labs/notes converted on-demand via `courseService.readLab()` / `readLo()`
4. HTML injected via `{@html lo.contentHtml}` in Svelte components

## Content types (defined in model lib)
- `note`, `lab` (multi-step), `talk` (PDF), `paneltalk`, `tutorial`, `archive`, `web`, `github`, `panelnote`, `panelvideo`, `podcast`
- Composites: `course`, `topic`, `unit`, `side`
- Lo base type has: `contentMd`, `contentHtml?`, `frontMatter: Properties`, `route`, `type`

## Key component patterns
- Content components: `Note.svelte`, `Lab.svelte`, `TalkClient.svelte` (switches Adobe/Mozilla PDF)
- External CSS loaded via `<svelte:head>` CDN links (see KaTeX in Lab/Note)
- `{#key currentCodeTheme.value}` wraps content for theme-reactive re-rendering
- All routes use `ssr = false`
"}
